reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Board Game Turn Rules 024
materials.text: Our board game uses one die. Roll it in the small tray. Move only your own piece. If the die falls on the floor, roll again in the tray. Wait until the next player finishes counting. At the end, put pieces in the cloth bag and the die in its little box.

questions.prompt: A friend rolls the die across the big table. You say, "____"
options: Roll it in the small tray.
questions.explanation: A骰子小盘内掷；B桌下、C水里非规则位置。

questions.prompt: A friend moves your piece for their turn. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B轮次只动本人棋子；A全动、C带走均不合。

questions.prompt: The die falls on the floor. Your friend starts counting it. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C落地重掷；A取落地数、B藏骰均违规则。

questions.prompt: A friend rolls while the next player is still counting. You say, "____"
options: Wait until the counting is finished.
questions.explanation: A等前人计完；B干扰数、C撤盘非解决轮次。

questions.prompt: A friend puts the die in the cloth bag after play. You say, "____"
options: Put all pieces in the little die box.
The die goes in its little box.
Leave the die on the floor.
questions.explanation: B骰子专盒；A棋子布袋不是小骰盒；C地上非收纳处。

units.title: 写一封信需要怎样求助

materials.title: Letter Writing Help 024
materials.text: A child is writing a real letter in class. Choose the sentence that asks for the needed help or information in each situation.

questions.prompt: You do not know your aunt’s address. What do you ask Dad?
questions.explanation: A问寄件所需收件地址；B球位、C信游泳均不获取地址。

questions.prompt: Your pen has no ink. You want to borrow another. What do you say?
options: May I borrow a pen, please?
questions.explanation: B缺墨借笔直接求助；A整桌、C安静偏好不补笔。

questions.prompt: You do not know how to spell a word. What do you ask the teacher?
options: How do I spell this word?
questions.explanation: C问拼写；A帽暖、B吃信封不解决字词。

questions.prompt: You have finished and want the teacher to check the address. What do you say?
options: Could you check the address, please?
questions.explanation: A请求核地址；B关窗、C浇花与邮寄核对无关。

questions.prompt: Your friend gives you a stamp. You want to thank them. What do you say?
options: You must give me ten more now.
questions.explanation: B就邮票明确感谢；A索更多不感谢；C鞋归属无关。

units.title: 宠物日的十段句内信息

materials.title: Pet Day Ten Sentences 024
materials.text: Read each full pet-day situation and choose the word or reply that completes it.

questions.prompt: My toy cat ____ a black tail. I made it with paper.
questions.explanation: B toy cat单数第三人称用has；A have不配单三；C having缺be不能独立谓语。

questions.prompt: Is your dog big? No, ____. It is very small.
questions.explanation: C No后it is not且下句small；A/B肯定与No冲突，B还误复数。

questions.prompt: Grandma does not ____ the fish at night. She feeds them in the morning.
questions.explanation: A does not后动词原形；B单三重复变形；C分词不合。

questions.prompt: These two ____ are sleeping beside their mother dog.
questions.explanation: B puppies标准复数，辅音y变ies；A单数；C拼写不合。

questions.prompt: The rabbit is hungry. Let us give ____ some grass.
questions.explanation: C give it作宾语；A its物主不能独立宾格；B自身反身结构无所需主宾同一。

questions.prompt: Please show ____ your drawing of the bird. I want to see it.
questions.explanation: A show me宾格；B my需名词；C I主格不作show宾语。

questions.prompt: The bowl is empty. There is not ____ water in it.
questions.explanation: B not any water正确，water不可数；A many修可数复数；C a不能直接修不可数water。

questions.prompt: ____ is holding the kitten? My uncle is.
questions.explanation: C My uncle答人物Who；A地点、B时间均不对应。

questions.prompt: The pet show starts at ten. We arrive ____ nine fifty.
questions.explanation: A具体时刻at；B on用于日，C in不接此具体钟点。

questions.prompt: Please be ____. The little birds are sleeping.
questions.explanation: B小鸟睡需安静；A吵与目的相反；C饥饿不实现不扰鸟的要求。

units.title: 运动社里的借用与辨认

materials.title: Sports Club Responses 024
materials.text:
Match the questions with the replies. Use every bank answer once.
A. Yes, if you bring it back after the game.
B. No, we need to wash them first.
C. At the small desk near the entrance.
D. Because the grass is too wet.
E. The one marked with your team’s name.

questions.prompt: May I borrow this ball for our game?
options: Yes, if you bring it back after the game.
No, we need to wash them first.
At the small desk near the entrance.
Because the grass is too wet.
The one marked with your team’s name.
questions.explanation: A借球可但赛后归还，答许可；B洗手、C领取点、D草湿原因、E队名辨认不回答借球条件。

questions.prompt: Can we eat with these dirty hands?
options: Yes, if you bring it back after the game.
No, we need to wash them first.
At the small desk near the entrance.
Because the grass is too wet.
The one marked with your team’s name.
questions.explanation: B先洗不脏手吃；A归球许可、C桌位、D草湿、E队名不答卫生许可。

questions.prompt: Where do we collect our score cards?
options: Yes, if you bring it back after the game.
No, we need to wash them first.
At the small desk near the entrance.
Because the grass is too wet.
The one marked with your team’s name.
questions.explanation: C入口附近小桌为领取地点；A/B许可答、D原因、E哪件都不答Where。

questions.prompt: Why are we playing in the hall today?
options: Yes, if you bring it back after the game.
No, we need to wash them first.
At the small desk near the entrance.
Because the grass is too wet.
The one marked with your team’s name.
questions.explanation: D草湿解释改室内；A还球、B洗手、C桌位置、E队名标记均非改场原因。

questions.prompt: Which bag of cones belongs to our team?
options: Yes, if you bring it back after the game.
No, we need to wash them first.
At the small desk near the entrance.
Because the grass is too wet.
The one marked with your team’s name.
questions.explanation: E本队名袋子答辨认；A归还许可、B洗手、C地点、D草湿不辨袋主。

units.title: 冬日出发前的衣物词库

materials.title: Winter Walk Bank 024
materials.text:
Choose from the shared bank. Use each word once. Bank: A. early B. beside C. warm D. gloves E. when
Our walk starts at nine, but we arrive ____1____ at eight thirty to help. We put the bags ____2____ the bench, not on it. The teacher asks us to wear ____3____ on our hands. They keep our fingers ____4____ in the cold wind. We begin walking ____5____ everyone is ready, not before.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A early因8:30早于九点；B beside位置、C warm状态、D gloves物品、E when连接词不表提前到。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B beside与not on对比表凳旁；A early副词、C warm形容词、D gloves名词、E when时间连接词均不接the bench表此位置。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: D gloves手套穿手上；A early、B beside、C warm、E when均非手部衣物。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: C warm作keep fingers表语对应冷风；A early早、B beside旁、D gloves手套、E when何时均不表手指温暖。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: E when连接everyone ready表出发条件时机；A early、B beside、C warm、D gloves均不能连接完整句表达该关系。

units.title: 纸建筑活动的工具安排

materials.title: Paper Building Dialogue 024
materials.text:
Match each question to the reply that fits it best. Use each reply once.
A. It is waiting on the teacher’s desk.
B. We need it for measuring the long paper.
C. After the first group has finished.
D. Yes, but please keep the pieces together.
E. The box with the triangle label.

questions.prompt: Where is the extra ruler now?
options: It is waiting on the teacher’s desk.
We need it for measuring the long paper.
After the first group has finished.
Yes, but please keep the pieces together.
The box with the triangle label.
questions.explanation: A教师桌上回答尺位置；B用途、C时间、D借用条件、E哪盒不答Where尺现位置。

questions.prompt: Why do we need the long ruler?
options: It is waiting on the teacher’s desk.
We need it for measuring the long paper.
After the first group has finished.
Yes, but please keep the pieces together.
The box with the triangle label.
questions.explanation: B量长纸解释需要长尺；A位置、C时机、D许可、E辨盒均不答Why。

questions.prompt: When can our group use the large table?
options: It is waiting on the teacher’s desk.
We need it for measuring the long paper.
After the first group has finished.
Yes, but please keep the pieces together.
The box with the triangle label.
questions.explanation: C第一组用完后答时机；A尺位置、B量纸目的、D借物许可、E箱标均不答When。

questions.prompt: May we borrow the model pieces for a test?
options: It is waiting on the teacher’s desk.
We need it for measuring the long paper.
After the first group has finished.
Yes, but please keep the pieces together.
The box with the triangle label.
questions.explanation: D可以但各件保持在一起，答借用许可条件；A尺位置、B目的、C桌时机、E箱标签都不答该许可。

questions.prompt: Which box holds the roof shapes?
options: It is waiting on the teacher’s desk.
We need it for measuring the long paper.
After the first group has finished.
Yes, but please keep the pieces together.
The box with the triangle label.
questions.explanation: E三角标签盒回答哪盒；A单个尺位置、B量纸理由、C时间、D借物许可均不提供盒标识。

materials.title: Small Map Big Walk 024
materials.text: Tomas takes a small map on a walk with his dad. He says the pond is on their left. Dad can see it on their right. They do not argue. Dad asks Tomas to find the school name on the map. The letters are upside down. Tomas turns the map around and checks the gate beside them. Now the pond and gate match what they see. He laughs and keeps the map the right way up for the rest of the walk.

questions.prompt: What do Tomas and Dad first disagree about?
questions.explanation: A池塘左右不同；B天空色、C晚饭时均未提。

questions.prompt: What clue shows the map is upside down?
options: The school letters are upside down.
questions.explanation: B校名字倒置；A缺页、C猫图无据。

questions.prompt: What does Tomas do to fix the problem?
questions.explanation: C旋转地图；A画池、B弃图均非行动。

questions.prompt: What do they use beside them to check the map?
questions.explanation: A旁边gate配池一起核；B火车、C蛋糕摊无据。

questions.prompt: How do they handle the disagreement?
options: By looking for evidence on the map and around them.
By ending the walk at once.
questions.explanation: B查文字方向与地标；A没争吵；C仍继续。

units.title: 翻谱员最后一页的等待

materials.title: Piano Recital Page Turn 024
materials.text:
For the school recital, Finn turned pages for his friend Rosa at the piano. In rehearsal, he always turned after the same line. During the performance, Rosa repeated a short section to recover from a mistake. Finn nearly turned too soon. He stopped when he saw her finger return to the start of the line.
Instead of counting the usual seconds, he followed the notes she was actually playing. The page turn happened later than planned, but Rosa continued smoothly. After the recital, Finn said he had worried that waiting meant he was doing his job badly. Rosa thanked him for watching her rather than the clock. For the next rehearsal, they agreed on a small nod to signal a turn if the music changed unexpectedly.

questions.prompt: What is Finn’s role?
questions.explanation: B帮翻谱；A选全曲、C修琴、D售票无据。

questions.prompt: Why does the usual turning time change?
options: Rosa repeats a section after a mistake.
questions.explanation: C重复小段延后进度；A/B/D非原因。

questions.prompt: What makes Finn stop before turning?
options: He sees Rosa return to the line’s start.
questions.explanation: A手指回行首提示仍在此页；B午饭铃、C拿谱、D空白无据。

questions.prompt: What does Rosa value about Finn’s response?
options: He follows only the planned seconds.
He changes every note for her.
He follows the music she is actually playing.
questions.explanation: D观察实际演奏；A正被替代；B/C非行为。

questions.prompt: What do they plan for the future?
options: Use a small nod for unexpected changes.
Turn every page before the music starts.
Ask the audience to turn pages.
questions.explanation: B小点头信号应变；A停练、C提前全翻、D观众翻均非约定。

units.title: 萤火虫观察活动的无闪光规则

materials.title: Camp Firefly Notice 024
materials.text: At the camp, our guide planned a short firefly walk. The note asked us to use the marked path, keep voices low and leave phone flashes off. It did not promise that we would see fireflies. Their activity depended on weather and other conditions. On the first night, strong wind led the guide to cancel the walk before we left camp. We watched a recorded talk indoors instead. The next evening was calm, and the walk went ahead. We saw only a few lights. The guide asked us to record what we actually saw, not copy a large number from another group’s report.

questions.prompt: The note guaranteed that every walk would show many fireflies.
questions.explanation: B正确：did not promise see且视条件；A把观察机会当保证。

questions.prompt: Phone flashes were to remain off.
questions.explanation: A正确：leave phone flashes off；B否认照明限制。

questions.prompt: The first night’s walk was cancelled before departure.
questions.explanation: A正确：strong wind cancel before left；B否认取消时间。

questions.prompt: The group stayed outdoors in strong wind to finish the walk.
questions.explanation: B正确：室内看录制讲座；A把替代活动改强行外走。

questions.prompt: The guide wanted an honest record of the few lights seen.
questions.explanation: A正确：record actually saw非抄他组大数；B否认记录要求。

units.title: 桥梁社展示日的词形记录

materials.title: Bridge Club Word Forms 024
materials.text:
Complete every gap with the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Last Friday, our group ____1____ (build) a paper bridge for the display.
2. The two ____2____ (child) from Class Six explained the test to visitors.
3. Our folded bridge was ____3____ (strong) than the flat one in this test.
4. Look at the helper. She is ____4____ (carry) the model with both hands.
5. We spoke ____5____ (clear; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) so everyone could hear the explanation.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use BUILD.
questions.explanation: 接受built：Last Friday提示过去，不规则build变built；build原形、builded错误过去式、building分词均不作所需过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use CHILD.
questions.explanation: 接受children：two要求child不规则复数；child单数，childs错误，childrens在复数再加s均不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use STRONG.
questions.explanation: 接受stronger：than明确比较；strong原级，strongest最高级，strongly副词均非所需比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use CARRY.
questions.explanation: 接受carrying：is和Look构成正在搬模型；carry原形、carried过去、carrys错误拼写均不成此处进行时。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from CLEAR.
questions.explanation: 接受clearly：本空明确要求CLEAR派生的常规-ly副词。clear的平义副词、clearer/clearest的比较或最高级可能在其他英语语境合法，但不满足本题-ly任务形式；clearness为名词也不合。未列形式仍按复核处理，不据本题判定这些词在所有英语中错误。

units.title: 出游途中澄清信息的五句话

materials.title: Trip Information Functions 024
materials.text: Choose the sentence that best achieves the stated purpose. Each question describes the whole communication need.

questions.prompt: The guide speaks too quickly, and you want the next instruction more slowly. What should you say?
options: Could you give the next instruction more slowly, please?
I will ignore the whole visit.
questions.explanation: B礼貌请求放慢下一步说明；A衣色无关；C放弃听指令不达澄清目标。

questions.prompt: Your ticket shows a different entrance from the sign. You want staff to check. What should you say?
options: I will use a closed door.
Could you check which entrance this ticket is for?
questions.explanation: C请员工核票入口以解冲突；A武断判错、B擅走闭门都非核实。

questions.prompt: A visitor has dropped a map, and you want to return it. What should you ask?
options: Excuse me, is this your map?
questions.explanation: A确认失物物主再归还；B鞋价、C买饭无关。

questions.prompt: You cannot join the optional walk and need to ask for the waiting place. What should you say?
options: I will disappear without telling anyone.
Where should I wait while the group walks?
Why do all maps have colours?
questions.explanation: B询替代等候点；A不告而走、C地图颜色不解决行程安排。

questions.prompt: You gave the wrong meeting time to a friend and now want to correct it. What should you say?
options: The old time is right because I said it first.
You should guess the time yourself.
I am sorry; I said ten, but the meeting is at ten thirty.
questions.explanation: C承认错误并给10:30正确时间；A固守先说信息、B让猜不纠正误导。
